# CondAb is generated by finitely presented projective objects　`prop.condab-generated`

[in graph](../#n=prop.condab-generated)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./prop.condab-generated.md)

## Notes · **draft**
**Proof.**
- **Generation**: $\mathrm{Cond}$ is generated by $\{h_{F}\}$ (with $F$ free compact Hausdorff). In general, if $\{X_{i}\}$ generates $\mathcal{C}$, then $\{\mathbb{Z}\cdot X_{i}\}$ generates $\mathrm{Ab}(\mathcal{C})$ (use the universal property of free abelian group objects: two morphisms agreeing on all $\mathbb{Z}\cdot X_{i}$ are equal).

Thus $\{\mathbb{Z}\cdot F\}$ generates $\mathrm{CondAb}$ ✓;
